result.requirement: The system shall route incoming order requests to the optimal Store Partner node and generate a corresponding Fulfillment Task for physical preparation and packing.
result.business_need: The business needs to direct demand to the most efficient physical node to ensure timely order preparation and accurate inventory utilization.
functional_behaviour: The system shall evaluate real-time inventory snapshots and store capacity to select the optimal Store Partner for each Order Request.
The system shall generate a Fulfillment Task containing item details, quantities, and special handling notes for the selected Store Partner.
The system shall assign a specific time window for order preparation and dispatch within the Fulfillment Task.
The system shall update the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to reflect reserved stock once the Fulfillment Task is created.
The system shall notify the Store Partner via the Fulfillment Task interface to initiate picking and packing operations.
related_information_requirements: Optimal store node selection criteria based on inventory and capacity
Specific list of items, quantities, and special handling notes
Assigned time window for preparation and dispatch
Current stock levels and availability status
business_rules: A Fulfillment Task must only be generated if the selected Store Partner has sufficient inventory for all items in the Order Request.
The assigned time window must allow the Store Partner to complete preparation before the delivery slot begins.
Stock reserved for a Fulfillment Task must be immediately reflected in the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to prevent overselling.
If no Store Partner meets the optimal criteria, the system shall flag the Order Request for manual review by the Platform Operator.

acceptance_criteria.given: An Order Request is received with valid items and quantities
acceptance_criteria.when: The system evaluates available Store Partners and their inventory
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a Fulfillment Task assigned to the optimal Store Partner with a valid time window

acceptance_criteria.given: No Store Partner has sufficient inventory for all items in an Order Request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to route the Order Request automatically
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the Order Request for manual review instead of generating a Fulfillment Task
